newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's RAMS overhauls loan products.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's RAMS overhauls loan products.

text.p: Australian mortgage originator RAMS Home Loans said on Monday it has overhauled its core loan products, adding new isurance products and offering a Visacard.
RAMS said the overhaul, which merged its Basic Home Loan and Better Home Loan, and offered a varible rate of 7.49 percent, also included a fixed rate option.
Under a new deal with QBE Insurance Group Ltd, RAMS would provide one years free home insurance to new Better Home Loan customers without obligation.
And through an alliance with Citicorp Life, customers would also be offered one years free home family protection issurance up to A$150,000 on the life of the primary borrwer.
RAMS also announced earlier on Monday that it would be jointly launching a Visa card with Colonial State Bank.

"These initiatives confirm RAMS' position as the leading non-bank mortgage provider -- it is the first time a mortgage provider has offered additional products with its core loan," said RAMS Managing Director, John Kinghorn.
"We believe that forming strategic allinces is the smart way of doing business in the rapidly changing finance industry," Kinghorn said in a statement.
